third look: no straight full-height base/picture boundary is visible. The neighbour ends sharply at ~131.7 (col 131 is ~25-40% base), then base 133-150 at R/G 2.2, B/G 0.56. The frame's dark foliage is at base density and ratio, with no step anywhere from 133 to past 200. The faint full-height denser band at ~150-157 that L4 used is a fixed sensor stripe, not film: the same dip (-1.4 to -4.2% against columns 6 away) sits at sensor cols 150-157 in all 70 frames of roll b0921c, and b0921c_58 matches the roll median to within 0.8%. For the same reason b0921c_59's faint outer at 259.2 (predicting 152.2) is the roll-wide stripe at sensor cols 258-262 (-5 to -10% in every frame), so it is void. b0922b_10 is from another session and has no stripe there: aligned, the film is flat in every channel from 133 to 199, and its 61.8 (predicting 150.8) marks where specks begin, not a boundary anyone saw. The only film-bound cue is sparse specks (the same rows 92-95 and 155-158 in both frames) whose left tips fall at cols 151-153 and ramp over about 4 columns, not a hard clip. So the edge is at or before ~151, probably 148-152 given the usual gap, but nothing visible marks it. Carried by: the roll-wide sensor-stripe check plus the flat b0922b_10 profile.

Cols 0-6 are featureless (green sd 1.0-1.5, the same as real base on b0922s_03) and the first highlights start at col 7. But the two leaves reaching that far (rows ~93 and ~156) taper to 1-2 px tips at cols 7-8 rather than being cut, and a locally stretched positive shows no straight vertical line. third look: EDGE, placed by the geometry of the frame. No visible line: the foliage background reads exactly at base in level, colour and noise, and its faint texture is no more repeatable across the three scans (s_09, b0922b_10, b0921a_17) in cols 7-23 than in 0-6. Only the sky highlights are film. Two measurements that do not use this side at all settled it. (1) FRAME WIDTH. This picture's RIGHT edge is a real, straight cut in b0922b_09's left sliver: many specks end on one vertical line at ~41.0, then certain base (42-61), then the next picture at 62.1. Registered into s_09 (k=400.6) that edge is at ~441.6. Six clean frames of this walk, each with its left edge in s_n and its right edge from the b-walk sliver registered into s_n, give a gate width W = 435.0-436.2 (mean 435.5), so the left edge is at ~6.1 +-0.7. For picture_to_border, W would have to be >=441.6, six columns wider than every other frame. (2) GAP. The neighbour's right edge in b0922b_10 is at 42.4, and five gaps on this roll measure 18.5-21.8, which puts the picture start at 5.9-9.2 here. (3) HIGHLIGHTS: the row-98 sky patch is already at ~75% of full density at col 7, and col 6 is at base in every row, so hi is 7.3. The leaves 'tapering' at cols 7-8 are compatible with a cut. L1's cols 0-6 are right, but the gate may be up to a column left of where the first speck sits. The row-222 speck at col 7 is a single one-channel pixel, like the noise hits in cols 0-5, so I don't count it.
